sys_script.description: REACTIVATED at order 150 (Stage 3). Previously inactive because it sat at order 100, the same order as "Invoice Total Calc", which SETS total_invoice_amount. At equal order the execution sequence between the two rules is indeterminate, so whenever this check ran first it validated a stale total and aborted legitimate saves. Moving it to 150 guarantees it runs AFTER "Invoice Total Calc" (order 100) and after "SnackFlow Invoice GST Calc" (order 50), so it now asserts the invariant on freshly computed values instead of competing to own the field. "Invoice Total Calc" is unchanged.
sys_script.name: Invoice Total Check
